performed_via_github_app.description:
Publish incredibly high performance websites and applications right from GitHub. The Netlify platform connects your repositories to an all-in-one workflow for global CDN deployment, continuous integration, and automatic (and free) HTTPS. Each time you commit changes, Netlify builds your site, prerenders markup, and optimizes assets on dedicated build infrastructure. Easily create an entirely automated workflows for your web applications

## Features

### Push your site live, directly from GitHub
Deploy your site to an ultra-redundant global CDN that’s purpose built for serving pages and assets quickly and consistently.

### Automate deployment
Netlify’s built-in Continuous Deployment automatically runs your build commands and deploys the result whenever you push to your Git repository.

### Add a custom domain
Purchase domains and manage DNS zones and records right inside of Netlify.

### HTTPS is automatic
Your site will automatically be secured with a free TLS certificate from Let’s Encrypt.

### Deploy Previews
Netlify’s Deploy Previews streamlined your workflow by giving you a unique, permanent URL to check what your changes will be like in production whenever you submit a pull request.

### And a lot more!
Netlify includes solutions for forms, identity, and even custom functions powered by AWS Lambda. And all this functionality can be configured directly in your repo.

Hey! Thanks for addressing this nasty iOS issue.

I was trying this out but I can't get the footer to render above the keyboard. Is this a bug or is it the intended layout? 

Demo:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc8cc5f6-6cb3-4eb0-a0c9-fa4a564aeaed

@stivaliserna This is intended atm. The provider keeps the drawer popup stable and scrolls the focused field into view inside the scrollable body but it doesn’t move footer/actions above the keyboard. Making the footer keyboard-persistent would force users into an explicit layout, such as a footer/scroll-area part, or keyboard inset CSS variable, which this PR is avoiding to ensure it works "out of the box" without manual config. 

Personally also, I don't think seeing the footer while the keyboard is open is that important and it would actually minimize the viewing height which is already somewhat constrained.

## Review summary

Ran a multi-aspect review over the source, tests, demos, and docs (general code quality, test coverage, error handling, type design, comment accuracy).

**Verdict: no blocking issues.** This is carefully written, convention-compliant code. The findings below are all hardening/polish — nothing must be fixed before merge.

### Critical issues
None found.

- **Error handling**: the two `try/finally` blocks (`restoreKeyboardScrollAdjustment`, `focusKeyboardInputWithoutPageScroll`) and the two empty `catch` blocks around `CSS.registerProperty` are all correct. The many silent `return` guards are intentional progressive-enhancement no-ops (the feature does nothing when no keyboard is detectable). No NaN-leak path — `parseFloat(...) || 0` plus finite arithmetic. Cleanup is symmetric: inline padding/overflow-anchor styles and the CSS var are always restored on close/unmount.
- **Conventions**: uses `useAnimationFrame`, `useStableCallback`, `ownerDocument`/`ownerWindow`, realm-safe `instanceof` (`win.HTMLInputElement`), shares handlers via context, demo CSS uses raw `oklch()` and pairs `-webkit-user-select`. ESLint clean (incl. `exhaustive-deps`).

### Important — test gaps worth addressing
Three behaviors currently have no direct coverage:

1. **`handleFocusOut` `relatedTarget` re-target branch is entirely untested** — [`DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx:248`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L248). When focus moves directly from one keyboard input to another, the code re-aligns without clearing inset/slack. A regression (clearing on every focusout) would briefly drop the inset between fields and go unnoticed. The existing "different scroll container" test exercises the `focusin` path, not this branch.
2. **`prefers-reduced-motion` → `behavior: 'auto'` is never asserted** — [`DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx:126`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L126). Only verifiable via a `scrollTo` spy under mocked `matchMedia`; final `scrollTop` is identical either way, so current tests can't catch a regression.
3. **The touchstart-ordering integration contract isn't locked in** — [`DrawerViewport.tsx:1085`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/viewport/DrawerViewport.tsx#L1085). This PR reorders `virtualKeyboard?.onTouchStart` to run *before* the swipe-ignore early return — the load-bearing seam for the iOS fix. A future refactor moving it back would silently break tap-to-focus, but no test asserts the ordering for the common (non-swipe-ignored) input.

The suite is otherwise genuinely strong (touch state machine, scroll-slack lifecycle, resize threshold, pinch-zoom guard, nested-drawer guard, label/contentEditable resolution, hit-slop probe are all well covered, with appropriate `it.skipIf(isJSDOM)` gating).

### Suggestions
- **Comments**: document the `KEYBOARD_SCROLL_SLACK = 48` magic number and why it's added only on top of existing overlap ([`:21`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L21) / [`:207`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L207)). Add a one-liner to the already-focused early-return guard at [`:356`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L356). (All existing platform-quirk comments were verified accurate.)
- **Types**: mark `KeyboardVisualViewport`'s `top`/`bottom` `readonly` to match the immutable-snapshot intent of `ScrollAdjustment` ([`:43`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L43)); a clarifying comment on `ScrollAdjustment` (why both string + parsed-number fields exist) would help. The empty `State {}`, the interface/value name sharing, and the optional non-throwing context hook all match existing Base UI conventions — leave as-is.
- **Docs nit**: [`page.mdx:147`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/drawer/page.mdx#L147) says the provider "scrolls the focused field into the visible viewport," but it actually *centers* the field and only scrolls when the container is scrollable. Minor wording.

### Strengths
- The `data-base-ui-swipe-ignore` focus path, picker-input (`type="date"`) preservation, and the off-screen-transform focus trick are exactly the iOS edge cases that silently regress — and they're tested.
- Comments document *why* (iOS quirks, slack-makes-container-scrollable) rather than restating code; [`:506`](https://github.com/mui/base-ui/blob/aca84a12bfd93a782332c7888f85df70f949fdb1/packages/react/src/drawer/virtual-keyboard-provider/DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider.tsx#L506) is exemplary.
- Public API surface (`types.md`, `page.mdx`, CSS var docs) is regenerated and consistent; demos accurately model the documented pattern.

## Review

No blocking issues — the keyboard provider path is correct. What's left is a couple of non-blocking tradeoffs and some optional test hardening.

### Tradeoffs (non-blocking)
- **Off-screen focus transform** — `focusKeyboardInputWithoutPageScroll` moves the input to `translateY(-2000px)` for the synchronous focus, which is observable to consumer `onFocus` handlers that read layout (they'd see `top ≈ -2000`). Worth keeping since it's doing real iOS work, but a one-line caveat comment would help future maintainers.
- **`--drawer-keyboard-inset` resets to `0px`** in some inactive states rather than being removed. Fine for provider-owned styling, though `removeProperty` would preserve `var(--drawer-keyboard-inset, <fallback>)` semantics more strictly.

### Optional test hardening (later)
Coverage is already strong (shadow-root focus, label targeting, click coordinates, hit-slop, contentEditable host, touchcancel, drag suppression, pinch-zoom, pickers, nested drawers, close cleanup, scroll-container switching, viewport math). Gaps worth closing eventually:
- focused field removed from the DOM **without** `focusout` (the self-correcting restore path)
- provider unmount while the inset is applied (asserts the CSS var is removed)
- a nested drawer opening **during** an active alignment (the `nestedDrawerOpen` branch in `alignFocusedKeyboardTarget`)
- the exact `KEYBOARD_RESIZE_THRESHOLD` (60px) boundary — only the below-threshold case exists
- a tap with jitter just under the 10px movement threshold — only the over-threshold case exists

### Leanness
No dead code — every helper has a call site, and `scrollable.ts` is a one-parameter addition (`allowOverflowIntent`) to an existing util shared with `useSwipeDismiss`, not a new file. The provider's line count maps to genuine iOS complexity (pinch-zoom suppression, tap-vs-drag, off-screen focus, slack save/restore, contentEditable resolution), not over-engineering.

Todo: figure out how to prevent native scroll for the input arrow key navigation on the virtual keyboard. Experimented with some things but they didn't work well. Vaul's seems to prevent navigating via input arrow keys on the virtual keyboard entirely (downwards) and doesn't reposition when going upwards.
